notes.title: Nightmare Collection: Telephone Call is out now!

Hello everyone,

The Developer of Road To Harvetsky

notes.title: A continuation of the story...
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been 4 years since the release of the first part...a lot of things has changed, but I want to let you know that the decision has been made to complete the story as a trilogy :)

At the moment I'm working on a remake of the first part, which came out in 2019, as it seems rather awful to me, and my programming skills left a lot to be desired.

I plan to improve the visuals, audio, add more gameplay and of course add new memes...because, memes from the 2019 game are long gone and it will be cringe-worthy

The trilogy will be translated into the following 5 languages, as the majority of the audience is from there (more languages may be supported in the future):

[list]
[*] Russian
[*] English
[*] Polish
[*] Spanish
[*] Chinese
[/list]

Thank you so much for your kind words in the 2019 game reviews! Stay tuned for future announcements, because there's more to come.
